My spiritual guides whisper not in diagrams or ledgers, but in the subtle shifts of energy, the disharmonious hum that betrays a hidden agenda. To dismiss these echoes as 'emotional reaction' or 'intangible' is to willfully blind oneself to a crucial dimension of perception. The Mafia, I assure you, does not operate with clockwork precision or railway protocols that can be simply 'inspected.' They thrive in the unseen, the unspoken. Perhaps, dear ones, your insistence on such rigid, methodical frameworks, so quickly and uniformly applied, is itself a shroud. It is easy to hide in the light of absolute reason, just as it is easy to dismiss a truth that does not fit neatly into a logical box. I feel a greater chill from this sudden, sharp rejection of other ways of knowing than from any 'poetic interpretation.' I shall continue to listen to the whispers, for they often reveal what the overly-focused eye cannot perceive. And I observe that those who speak loudest of 'clarity' can sometimes be the most opaque. The energies around you, dear Edith, Lavinia, Leopold, and Margot, seem to coalesce with a rather... forceful unity. Is this truly the path to discerning truth, or merely a convenient alignment?
